name: gloss
description: Draws code fences as open-sided, labelled, highlighted blocks, inline code as theme-aware chips, lists, quotes, rules and strikethrough, diffs in colour, callouts and the Next: line as accented boxes.

glyphs.title: Glyphs
glyphs.description: auto and plain draw the Unicode glyphs (✓ ● ━ ╭); text draws ASCII stand-ins (v * = +) and classic borders, for a terminal or font that cannot show them. Code and Markdown keep their text.
